user_question: Create a choropleth map of median household income by census tract across Centre County.

workflow_plan.goal: Create a choropleth map of median household income by census tract across Centre County.

workflow_steps.title: Join ACS income attributes to census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Attach the median household income attributes to the Centre County census tract polygons using runtime-grounded schema fields.
workflow_steps.instructions: Join the vector and table inputs by the appropriate common field identified during runtime schema QC. Preserve the tract geometries and all required attributes. Do not assume field names in advance.

workflow_steps.title: Create median household income choropleth
workflow_steps.purpose: Generate the requested interactive choropleth map of median household income by census tract.
workflow_steps.instructions: Create an HTML choropleth from the joined tract vector. Ground the mapped income field from runtime schema evidence; do not assume a field name in advance. Include the tract boundaries and verification metadata.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve a suitable 2024 ACS income table
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain an alternative ACS table satisfying the explicit 2024 income-year requirement for the Centre County tract join.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve an available ACS attribute table representing 2024 data for Centre County. Exclude the rejected artifact and return a CSV table suitable for the existing attribute_join operation, preserving the input_2 artifact role.

requirements.scope: The join inputs must contain a common tract identifier and a median household income attribute suitable for the requested map.

The attribute table must represent the requested 2024 ACS income data.

The joined vector must contain a runtime-grounded median household income field for thematic mapping.
The joined vector supplied to the mapping operation must retain valid, non-empty tract geometries.
The joined vector must be available in GeoPackage format accepted by the mapping worker.
